# cloudxino_dns_zone (Resource)

A DNS zone hosted on CloudXino's nameservers. Point the domain's nameservers at `nameservers` to make it active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudxino_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# Set these at the domain's registrar.
output "nameservers" {
  value = cloudxino_dns_zone.example.nameservers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain, e.g. `example.com` (lower case, no trailing dot).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Set these as the domain's nameservers at its registrar.
- `status` (String) `pending` until the domain points at our nameservers, then `active`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_dns_zone.example <zone_id>
```
